result.note: Brief item; tested the partner country for the Innovation Roadmap 2030, adopted in June 2026.

questions.prompt: In June 2026, India adopted the 'Innovation Roadmap 2030', which covers trusted AI, space and mobility, with which country?
questions.explain: India and France adopted the Innovation Roadmap 2030 on 16 June 2026. It aims to build a tech ecosystem in trusted AI, space and mobility that is independent of both Washington and Beijing.
questions.source: India and France adopted the Innovation Roadmap 2030, building a tech ecosystem in trusted AI, space, and mobility independent of both Washington and Beijing.
